_comment: Type-checks the shared engine from its JSDoc annotations. There is still no
build step and no compiler output - npm run typecheck only reads.
A 2,600-line untyped engine that four UI surfaces share is exactly where a
renamed field goes unnoticed until a report renders blank.
Scope is the engine only. It is browser code, so it needs no Node types, and
pulling those in dragged dependency JS into the program. The Node-side
scripts (eval/, test/, scripts/) are covered by eslint instead.
